story.iWant: the "Reader" agent to analyze the content of my uploaded document
story.soThat: it can be used to generate study materials
story.tasks: - [ ] **Backend:** - [ ] Implement the `ReaderAgent` service. (AC: #3, #4, #5, #6) - [ ] Add a method to receive the `ConversationContext`. - [ ] Implement the logic to call the LLM with a prompt for summarization and key concept extraction. - [ ] Implement the logic to parse the LLM response and update the `ConversationContext`. - [ ] **Stateful Orchestrator:** - [ ] Add a routing rule to direct analysis requests to the `ReaderAgent`. (AC: #2) - [ ] **Testing:** - [ ] Write unit tests for the `ReaderAgent` service to verify LLM interaction and context updates. (AC: #4, #5, #6) - [ ] Write an integration test to ensure the `Stateful Orchestrator` correctly routes a request to the `ReaderAgent` and the session context is updated. (AC: #1, #2, #6) - [ ] Write a performance test to ensure the analysis completes within the NFR timeframe. (AC: #7)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. **Given** a document has been successfully uploaded and its text extracted (via OCR if necessary), 2. **When** the `Stateful Orchestrator` routes the analysis request to the "Reader" agent, 3. **Then** the "Reader" agent SHALL process the document's `raw_text`. 4. **And** the agent SHALL generate a concise summary of the document. 5. **And** the agent SHALL extract a list of key concepts from the document. 6. **And** the generated summary and key concepts SHALL be stored in the user's session context. 7. **And** the entire analysis process SHALL be completed within the time defined by **NFR8.1.1**.

doc.title: AI Buddy - Epics
doc.snippet: Goal: Build the core document processing pipeline, including file upload, OCR, and the "Reader" agent for content analysis.

doc.title: Product Requirements Document: AI Buddy
doc.snippet: FR6.1: The backend SHALL orchestrate a "Reader" agent to process and analyze uploaded documents.

doc.title: Architecture: AI Buddy
doc.snippet: The Stateful Orchestrator is a central backend service that manages the lifecycle of a user's interaction. It maintains the conversation state and routes requests to the appropriate specialist AI agent (e.g., Reader, Coach) based on the current context.

file.reason: This service will need to be modified to add a routing rule for the new ReaderAgent.
This is the new service to be created for this story.

constraints.constraint: The analysis must be grounded in the provided document text to avoid hallucinations.
All timestamps on the backend/database will be in UTC.

tests.standards: We will use the "Testing Pyramid" strategy: many Unit Tests (Pytest, Jest), some Integration Tests, and a few End-to-End Tests.
tests.ideas: - (AC: #4, #5, #6) Unit test the `ReaderAgent` with mock LLM responses to ensure it correctly parses summaries and key concepts and updates the context. - (AC: #1, #2, #6) Integration test the `StatefulOrchestrator` to verify that a request with a "read document" intent is correctly routed to the `ReaderAgent`. - (AC: #7) Performance test the end-to-end analysis process to ensure it meets the 10-second requirement under load.
